description_en: Queries the execution results of commands delivered by calling RunAppInstanceCommand in persistent sessions, including the execution status, start and end times, and command output
description_zh: 查询通过 RunAppInstanceCommand 下发的命令在持久会话中的执行结果，包括执行状态、开始和结束时间以及命令输出
name: ListCommandInvocationResults

parameters.help_en: The product type. Currently, only WuyingServer is supported. If you specify other values, a parameter error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型。当前仅支持 WuyingServer，传入其他值时返回参数错误
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the delivery group. Queries the command execution results under this delivery group. This parameter must be specified when AppInstanceGroupIds is not specified. If both are specified, AppInstanceGroupIds takes precedence and this parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 交付组ID，查询该交付组下的命令执行结果。未指定 AppInstanceGroupIds 时必须指定该参数；同时指定时以 AppInstanceGroupIds 为准，该参数不生效
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of delivery group IDs. A maximum of 200 IDs can be specified, and all delivery groups must be in the same region. When specified, it takes precedence over AppInstanceGroupId and queries the command execution results of all persistent sessions under these delivery groups. The list cannot contain null values
parameters.help_zh: 交付组ID列表，最多 200 个，所有交付组必须位于同一地域。指定后优先于 AppInstanceGroupId 生效，查询这些交付组下全部持久会话的命令执行结果；列表中不能包含空值
parameters.name: app_instance_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of persistent session IDs. A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified. It is used to query only the command execution results of the specified persistent sessions. When AppInstanceGroupIds is specified, only persistent sessions belonging to these delivery groups are retained. If no matching persistent sessions are found, an empty list is returned
parameters.help_zh: 持久会话ID列表，最多 100 个，用于只查询指定持久会话的命令执行结果。指定 AppInstanceGroupIds 时，仅保留属于这些交付组的持久会话，没有匹配的持久会话时返回空列表
parameters.name: app_instance_persistent_ids

parameters.help_en: The command execution ID, which is the InvocationId returned when you call RunAppInstanceCommand to deliver a command
parameters.help_zh: 命令执行ID，即调用 RunAppInstanceCommand 下发命令时返回的 InvocationId
parameters.name: invocation_id

parameters.help_en: The number of query results per page. Default value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页的查询结果数量，默认值为 200
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the query results to display. It is used together with PageSize for paging in a paged query. If not specified, the default value is 0, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 需展示的查询结果页码，与 PageSize 配合分页查询。不传时默认为 0，按首页查询
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: This parameter does not take effect in the current version and does not affect the query results if passed. Use PageNumber and PageSize for pagination
parameters.help_zh: 当前版本不生效，传入后不影响查询结果。请使用 PageNumber 和 PageSize 进行分页
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: This parameter does not take effect in the current version and does not affect the query results if passed. Use PageNumber and PageSize for pagination
parameters.help_zh: 当前版本不生效，传入后不影响查询结果。请使用 PageNumber 和 PageSize 进行分页
parameters.name: next_token

schema.description_en: The response for querying command execution results, which includes the request ID, the list of command execution results, and the total number of query results
schema.description_zh: 查询命令执行结果的响应，包含请求ID、命令执行结果列表和查询结果总数

CommandInvocationResultModel.description_en: The list of command execution results. Each element corresponds to an execution record on a persistent session. If no records meet the conditions, an empty array is returned
CommandInvocationResultModel.description_zh: 命令执行结果列表，每个元素对应一个持久会话上的执行记录。没有符合条件的记录时返回空数组

AppInstanceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the delivery group to which the persistent session that executed the command belongs
AppInstanceGroupId.description_zh: 执行命令的持久会话所属的交付组ID

AppInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the app that executed the command

AppInstancePersistentId.description_en: The ID of the persistent session that executed the command

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the command execution finished. The time is in UTC and follows the RFC 3339 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. It is an empty string if the command execution has not finished
FinishTime.description_zh: 命令执行结束的时间，使用 UTC 时间，按照 RFC 3339 标准表示，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。命令尚未执行结束时为空字符串

InvocationId.description_en: The command execution ID, which is the same as the request parameter InvocationId
InvocationId.description_zh: 命令执行ID，与请求参数 InvocationId 一致

InvocationStatus.description_en: The execution status of the command on the persistent session, such as Pending (waiting to be executed), Running (executing), Success (executed successfully), and Timeout (execution timed out)
InvocationStatus.description_zh: 命令在该持久会话上的执行状态，例如 Pending（等待执行）、Running（执行中）、Success（执行成功）、Timeout（执行超时）

Output.description_en: The output content generated by the command execution, which is raw text. It is an empty string if the command has not finished or has no output
Output.description_zh: 命令执行产生的输出内容，为原始文本。命令尚未结束或没有输出时为空字符串

StartTime.description_en: The time when the command started to execute. The time is in UTC and follows the RFC 3339 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. It is an empty string if the command has not started to execute
StartTime.description_zh: 命令开始执行的时间，使用 UTC 时间，按照 RFC 3339 标准表示，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。命令尚未开始执行时为空字符串

MaxResults.description_en: This field is not returned in the current version. Use PageNumber, PageSize, and TotalCount for pagination
MaxResults.description_zh: 当前版本不返回该字段，请使用 PageNumber、PageSize 和 TotalCount 进行分页

NextToken.description_en: This field is not returned in the current version. Use PageNumber, PageSize, and TotalCount for pagination
NextToken.description_zh: 当前版本不返回该字段，请使用 PageNumber、PageSize 和 TotalCount 进行分页

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the currently displayed query results. In the current version, this field always returns 0 and does not echo echo request parameter PageNumber. Refer to echo request parameter for the actual value
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前展示的查询结果页码。当前版本该字段固定返回 0，不回显请求参数 PageNumber，请以请求参数为准

PageSize.description_en: The number of query results per page. In the current version, this field always returns 0 and does not echo echo request parameter PageSize. Refer to echo request parameter for the actual value
PageSize.description_zh: 每页的查询结果数量。当前版本该字段固定返回 0，不回显请求参数 PageSize，请以请求参数为准

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of query results. If no records meet the conditions, 0 is returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询结果的总数。没有符合条件的记录时返回 0
